# AI Man Jack

> AI Man Jack (aimanjack.com) is Jack Qian's Dallas, Texas practice. Two things: hands-on AI training for teams (in English or Chinese — 90-minute lunch-and-learns, half-day workshops, multi-week programs; no public price list, quotes after a 20-minute call), and a done-for-you AI front desk for Dallas–Fort Worth appointment practices (dental, med spa, chiropractic/PT, acupuncture, salons): an AI that answers patients and books appointments 24/7, on a booking-first website, $2,000 one-time for all three (AI front desk, booking system, website) then $200/month. It starts by calling the AI demo line +1 (469) 517-2968: the AI answers, and books the caller's fifteen-minute call with Jack — the same booking system that gets installed. Contact: jack@aimanjack.com, +1 (469) 425-4142 (text TRAINING with a company name for the training side). Service area: the whole Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex (Texas, USA) — Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Richardson, Frisco, McKinney, Arlington and everywhere between.

Key facts:
- Profiles: X https://x.com/JackQianAI · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@JackBuildAI · GitHub https://github.com/qianquandong · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/quandong-qian-156563191/ · Threads https://www.threads.com/@jack_qian616 · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100084925451350 · Nextdoor https://nextdoor.com/page/ai-man-jack-melissa-tx/ · Douyin (抖音) "AI人Jack" https://www.douyin.com/user/MS4wLjABAAAAxNXwx4UCCwS2FwyO-bsDHbuWziAo5mszf_EHC8qbxSI_hlNPcRl6nKO1v6aRFMxK

- Founder: Jack Qian, Dallas AI trainer and community AI educator. Has run five community AI talks of 50+ people each in Plano and Dallas in 2026 and a 37-person AI hackathon (April 2026).
- AI training for teams: task-first curriculum in five parts — choose a suitable task, give the AI useful context, move from chat to a workflow, verify the output, apply data and approval guardrails. Participants leave with one working workflow for a task they already do, not a tool tour. Formats: 90-minute lunch-and-learn, half-day hands-on workshop, multi-week program. English or Chinese. Priced per engagement after a short call.
- AI front desk + booking system (Products): a done-for-you AI that answers customers and books appointments 24/7 for Dallas–Fort Worth appointment practices. $2,000 one-time covers all three — the AI front desk, the booking system, and the booking-first website it runs on — then $200/month to keep it running. A tuned Google Business Profile is included. Live within a week. The entry point is the live AI line +1 (469) 517-2968: it answers, and books the caller's fifteen-minute call with Jack, so a prospect uses the product before talking to a human.
